## Summary
The §18 evaluation-program **execution layer** — a new package **`@rhema/benchmark-runner`** that orchestrates the P0.13 `@rhema/benchmark` scorers + data layer over a wave. It **never re-implements scoring**; it drives the existing deterministic scorers and adds the arms, normalization, human-adjudication tooling, LLM-judge hardening, pre-registration, and the wave runner + report.

Implements ticket `docs/tickets/15_P0.14__benchmark-arms-and-wave-runner.md`; stacked on PR #15 (P0.13).

## What changed
- **`packages/benchmark-runner/`** — new package: `arms.ts`, `normalization.ts`, `matching.ts`, `adjudication.ts`, `judges.ts`, `checks.ts`, `preregistration.ts`, `cadence.ts`, `wave-runner.ts`, `report.ts`, `hash.ts`, `testing/` + colocated tests (43 tests).
- **`packages/db/migrations/0014_benchmark_runner.sql`** — 11 additive tables (arm configs, normalized findings, extraction audits, match records, pairwise preferences, judge calibrations/scores, pre-registrations, deviations, wave reports, consequence log), granted only to the `rhema_benchmark` role.
- **`packages/db/src/schema/benchmark.ts`** — Drizzle mirror of the new tables (schema-parity test green).
- Root `tsconfig.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml` register the package; `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` closes the P0.14 half of D-P0.13-2 + hashing half of D-P0.13-4, logs D-P0.14-1..3.

## Design decisions
- **Separate package** makes P0.13's "owns schemas+scoring" vs P0.14's "orchestrates" boundary physical (the runner imports scorers from `@rhema/benchmark`).
- **DI seams** — `ArmExecutor` (live A4/A5 engine binding is P0.15) and `JudgeModel` (cross-family LLM judge) — keep the whole layer deterministic in tests and land heavy bindings where they belong.
- **Headline = reference-based** (8 metrics, deterministic scorers); **secondary = human-rubric/pairwise/LLM-judged** (4 metrics). Pairwise is structurally barred from the headline path.
- **Config/pre-registration hashing** is canonical (key-order-independent) so a hash mismatch is a real change (a deviation), never a serialization artifact.

## Verification
- `vitest run packages/benchmark-runner` → **43 passed**; `packages/db` → 26 passed (incl. schema-parity + migrate); baseline `@rhema/benchmark` 67 unchanged.
- `pnpm turbo build lint typecheck` → **96/96 tasks green**.
- End-to-end **dev-set dry run** exercises all six arms (A6 via intake), normalization, blind matching, twelve metrics, and the report's public/private split.
- An **independent fresh-context review** (design + spec-gap) ran; its 2 MAJOR + 6 MINOR + relevant NIT findings were all fixed (dev-set/pilot report now labeled `preliminary`/`devSet`; C-e now runs `styleControl`; LIFT uses paired per-draft recall + voice-conformance guard rail; provider gate keys on a distinct provider; judge withholding surfaced in the report; drift detected at render; injected clock threaded through all inserts).
